newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Daiwa Asso in HK$40.3 mln rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Daiwa Asso in HK$40.3 mln rights issue.

text.p: Daiwa Associates Holdings Ltd said it proposed to raise about HK$40.3 million before expenses by way of a rights issue of 144 million shares on the basis of one rights share for every two shares held at HK$0.28 each.

Among the net proceed after expenses of about HK$37.7 million, HK$27 million will be used to repay bank borrowings and the remaining HK$10.7 million will be for general working capital, the electronic components manufacturer said.
The company shares fell HK$0.025 or 7.04 percent to HK$0.33 each in early morning trade.
